card.name: Inside capitalized FREQUENT in warnings
card.fires_on: The pieces of the word FREQUENT or FREQUENTLY (FRE-QU-ENT-LY) when written in capital letters in boxed warnings about monitoring. It also fires weakly on lowercase 'frequent' after 'Obtain'.

modes.label: Capitalized FREQUENT split
modes.description: The QU or ENT piece inside all-caps FREQUENT or FREQUENTLY in warning text about monitoring.
modes.example: SERUM ELECTROLYTES SHOULD BE MONITORED FRE<<QU>>ENTLY.

modes.label: Lowercase frequent
modes.description: The whole word 'frequent' before blood counts or monitoring.
modes.example: . Obtain<< frequent>> blood counts to monitor for neutropenia

card.writes: It pushes toward finishing or repeating forms of 'frequent' and 'missing', which suggests word-completion help.
card.plain: It spots the word FREQUENT being spelled out in capital letters in warnings about how often to check labs.
